_notes.source: Live site read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 - elitetraderfunding.com now redirects to elitetraderfunding.app: plan cards on https://elitetraderfunding.app/evaluations (all six plan tabs clicked through), /about, /affiliates, /help/refund-policy, /help/consistency-rule-and-active-trade-days-atd-explained, /help/how-the-1-step-plan-works. Earlier help-centre pages (2026-10-11) listed in git history; Trustpilot https://www.trustpilot.com/review/elitetraderfunding.com.
_notes.pricing: All prices USD. standard = the full monthly price on each plan card; promo = the sale price shown next to it (90% off; a site pop-up says 'Start for 90% off and keep saving every month', ending in about 12 days as of 2026-10-20). No code is shown, so promo_code is null and the discount shows as 'current promo'. Evaluations auto-renew every 30 days until passed. After passing: activation fee $87/month, or a one-time activation fee of $177 (1-Step 50K, EOD 50K, all Static), $247 (1-Step 100K/150K), $257 (EOD 100K). Reset fee $47.
_notes.rules_detail: From the plan cards (2026-10-20): 1-Step: profit target $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000, max loss $2,000 / $3,000 / $5,000 trailing open and realised profit, no daily loss limit, 5 min trade days. End of Day: target $3,000 / $6,000, max loss $2,000 / $3,500 trailing end-of-day realised profit, daily loss limit $1,100 / $2,200 (hard breach), 5 min trade days. 150K EOD no longer shown. Static: target $1,000 / $2,000 / $4,000, static max drawdown $500 / $1,000 / $2,000 (never trails), no daily loss limit, 5 min trade days. Payout days: 8 Active Trade Days (ATDs) for the first payout; for evaluations bought from 2 Oct 2026 an ATD needs at least $250 realised profit and at least 30% of the best day ($125 for 10K/25K Static). That ATD rule is ETF's consistency mechanism, not a single consistency %, so consistency_pct stays null. Profit split: traders keep up to 100% of simulated profits up to a $25,000 lifetime reward cap, then move to live (help centre).
_notes.payout_caps: First reward-cycle maximum recorded; caps rise in later cycles (e.g. 1-Step 50K: $1,000 / $1,250 / $1,500 / $1,750; Static and EOD 50K: $1,250 / $1,500 / $1,750 / $2,000).
_notes.payout_wording: The help centre has a '48-Hour Reward Guarantee' article (a promise about payout processing time). We don't repeat that wording.
_notes.not_listed: Seen on the live plans page 2026-10-20 but not listed as tiers (different structures, check before adding): Direct to Funded - pay once, 10K Mini Inferno $357, 50K $747, 100K $997, no activation fee; Diamond Hands - 100K only, $397 (sale $39.70) monthly, target $5,000, max loss $3,500 EOD, daily loss $1,500, 2 minis; Fast Track - pay once, 10K EOD $57 and 10K Static $77, target $2,000, max loss $500, 40% consistency, 3 min days. The 150K End of Day and 250K 1-Step are no longer sold.
_notes.countries: Restricted list = countries restricted by Rise, ETF's reward provider (auto-updated list, last verified by ETF 30 Jul 2026). You also need a country supported by Stripe for payments, and OFAC-sanctioned countries can't move to the live account. Guam, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands are unsupported.
_notes.company: About page (2026-10-20): founded 14 February 2022 by Kanwal Singh; team spread across Asia, the Americas, Africa and Europe. No head-office address stated, so hq = null. No Google Business listing found.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 3.8 from 1,158 reviews. 6 of the 20 newest reviews described a refused or forfeited payout; the firm replied to most. Borderline, similar to firms already listed. Passed with a warning.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official ETF page we could read. Prices especially need screenshots.
_notes.fee_refund: Refund policy (2026-10-20): 'All sales are final', except a '100% Satisfaction Guarantee' with conditions. Fee not refunded with payouts, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://elitetraderfunding.app/affiliates (2026-10-20): 15% of referred sales for 45 days on 1-Step, Diamond Hands and EOD evaluations; 7% on Static; 3% on Intermediate. Cookie: 45 days, and first referrer keeps credit even if the trader clicks another affiliate's link later. Payouts: request by email to the payroll team, processed Fridays, 7-10 business days, $40 withdrawal fee per payout, one payout per month; KYC identity and address check at payout. Requirements: active on social media, YouTube, podcasts or a blog; passive methods (paid ads, coupon sites) are not allowed and payouts are denied for them. Comparison sites are not mentioned either way. UAE affiliates: no country rule stated beyond KYC. Elite affiliates can get custom coupon codes. Apply: sign up for an account, then the affiliate area (page above).

firm.name: Elite Trader Funding
firm.about: Elite Trader Funding (ETF) is a futures prop firm selling subscription evaluations, including a 1-Step plan with a trailing drawdown, an End of Day plan and a Static plan. Funded traders who reach a lifetime reward cap move on to trading a live account.

countries.notes: These are the countries ETF's payout provider (Rise) can't serve. Your country must also be supported by Stripe, ETF's payment provider, and residents of OFAC-sanctioned countries can't move to a live account. Guam, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands aren't supported.
